Dear [Hiring Manager],  

I’ve worked alongside Binta Traore on cross-team integration projects at AdvertiseSphere Inc., where she served as a key liaison between engineering and product teams. Her ability to translate technical constraints into actionable insights made her an invaluable collaborator.  

Binta’s strength lies in her technical curiosity and adaptability. She consistently bridges gaps between stakeholders by asking the right questions and proposing pragmatic solutions. During a recent campaign launch, she identified a workflow bottleneck that was slowing deployment timelines. Rather than defaulting to standard fixes, she reimagined the process by integrating real-time feedback loops, which reduced delays by over 40% without overhauling the entire system.  

What stands out is her quiet reliability. When a critical bug surfaced during a high-stakes release, she stayed late to debug the issue, coordinating with multiple teams to isolate the root cause. Her calm under pressure and attention to detail ensured the fix was deployed seamlessly. Beyond technical skills, Binta’s collaborative spirit fosters trust—she’s equally comfortable explaining complex systems to non-technical teammates as she is mentoring junior engineers.  

In sum, Binta’s blend of technical acumen, problem-solving grit, and teamwork makes her a strong fit for any dynamic adtech environment. She’d bring both expertise and approachability to your team.  

Best regards,
